info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Estimates-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates Retrieval API provides access to estimate data for customer utility bills. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed billing estimates for a specified period, facilitating accurate financial planning and budgeting. Common consumers include utility providers, financial analysts, and developers integrating billing functionalities into applications. Utilize this API to enhance customer service experiences and improve transparency in utility billing processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain an estimated billing amount based on the provided parameters. It is useful for users who want to understand potential costs before proceeding with transactions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to request a billing estimate. It should contain the relevant billing parameters to generate an accurate estimate.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing estimates in JSON format.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the estimate.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the estimate.

state.description: The current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the billing estimate operation, indicating the status and details of the estimate.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the estimate.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the estimate was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the estimate was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit details for the billing estimate operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
